content.title: Understanding End-to-End Test Automation Architecture
content.explanation: End-to-end test automation requires a strategic architecture that integrates multiple testing layers (web UI, API, database) while maintaining separation of concerns, reusability, and scalability. The architecture must support parallel execution, comprehensive reporting, environment management, and seamless CI/CD integration. A well-designed e2e framework acts as a quality gatekeeper, providing fast feedback while covering critical business flows across all application layers.

# config/base_config.py
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
from enum import Enum

class Environment(Enum):
    LOCAL = "local"
    DEV = "development"
    STAGING = "staging"
    PRODUCTION = "production"

@dataclass
class BaseConfig:
    """Base configuration class with environment-specific defaults"""
    
    # Environment settings
    environment: Environment = Environment.LOCAL
    debug: bool = False
    
    # Application URLs
    base_url: str = "http://localhost:3000"
    api_base_url: str = "http://localhost:8000/api/v1"
    
    # Database configuration
    db_host: str = "localhost"
    db_port: int = 3306
    db_name: str = "shopsmart_test"
    db_user: str = "test_user"
    db_password: str = "test_password"
    db_driver: str = "mysql"
    
    # Browser settings
    browser: str = "chrome"
    headless: bool = False
    browser_timeout: int = 30
    window_width: int = 1920
    window_height: int = 1080
    
    # API settings
    api_timeout: int = 10
    api_retry_attempts: int = 3
    api_retry_delay: int = 1
    
    # Test execution settings
    test_timeout: int = 300
    implicit_wait: int = 10
    explicit_wait: int = 30
    parallel_workers: int = 4
    
    # Reporting and logging
    generate_html_report: bool = True
    generate_allure_report: bool = True
    report_path: str = "reports/"
    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_file: str = "logs/test_execution.log"
    
    # Screenshots and videos
    screenshot_on_failure: bool = True
    screenshot_on_success: bool = False
    screenshot_path: str = "screenshots/"
    record_video: bool = False
    video_path: str = "videos/"
    
    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls):
        """Load configuration from environment variables with fallbacks"""
        return cls(
            environment=Environment(os.getenv("ENVIRONMENT", "local")),
            base_url=os.getenv("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:3000"),
            api_base_url=os.getenv("API_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8000/api/v1"),
            db_host=os.getenv("DB_HOST", "localhost"),
            db_port=int(os.getenv("DB_PORT", "3306")),
            db_name=os.getenv("DB_NAME", "shopsmart_test"),
            db_user=os.getenv("DB_USER", "test_user"),
            db_password=os.getenv("DB_PASSWORD", "test_password"),
            browser=os.getenv("BROWSER", "chrome"),
            headless=os.getenv("HEADLESS", "false").lower() == "true",
            log_level=os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"),
            parallel_workers=int(os.getenv("PARALLEL_WORKERS", "4"))
        )

# Environment-specific configurations
class DevelopmentConfig(BaseConfig):
    """Development environment configuration"""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.environment = Environment.DEV
        self.base_url = "https://dev.shopsmart.com"
        self.api_base_url = "https://dev-api.shopsmart.com/api/v1"
        self.headless = True
        self.debug = True

class StagingConfig(BaseConfig):
    """Staging environment configuration"""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.environment = Environment.STAGING
        self.base_url = "https://staging.shopsmart.com"
        self.api_base_url = "https://staging-api.shopsmart.com/api/v1"
        self.headless = True
        self.browser = "firefox"  # Cross-browser testing in staging
        self.parallel_workers = 8

class ProductionConfig(BaseConfig):
    """Production environment configuration"""
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.environment = Environment.PRODUCTION
        self.base_url = "https://shopsmart.com"
        self.api_base_url = "https://api.shopsmart.com/api/v1"
        self.headless = True
        self.screenshot_on_success = False  # Don't take screenshots in prod
        self.parallel_workers = 12

# Configuration factory
def get_config(env: str = None) -> BaseConfig:
    """Get configuration for specified environment"""
    env = env or os.getenv("ENVIRONMENT", "local")
    
    config_map = {
        "local": BaseConfig,
        "development": DevelopmentConfig,
        "dev": DevelopmentConfig,
        "staging": StagingConfig,
        "production": ProductionConfig,
        "prod": ProductionConfig
    }
    
    config_class = config_map.get(env.lower(), BaseConfig)
    return config_class()

content.code:
# src/web/page_objects/base_page.py
from typing import Tuple, Optional, List, Union, Callable
from playwright.sync_api import Page, Locator, expect, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError
import allure
from datetime import datetime
import os
import time
from src.core.logger import get_logger

logger = get_logger(__name__)

class BasePage:
    """Base Page Object with common functionality for all pages"""
    
    def __init__(self, page: Page):
        self.page = page
        self.timeout = 30000  # 30 seconds default timeout
        self.poll_frequency = 100  # Poll every 100ms
        
    # Navigation methods
    def navigate(self, url: str) -> 'BasePage':
        """Navigate to a URL with comprehensive logging"""
        with allure.step(f"Navigate to {url}"):
            logger.info(f"Navigating to URL: {url}")
            self.page.goto(url, timeout=self.timeout, wait_until="networkidle")
            self.wait_for_page_load()
            logger.info(f"Successfully navigated to {url}")
        return self
    
    def wait_for_page_load(self, timeout: Optional[int] = None) -> 'BasePage':
        """Wait for page to load completely"""
        timeout = timeout or self.timeout
        
        # Wait for network to be idle
        self.page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle", timeout=timeout)
        
        # Additional check for single-page applications
        self.page.wait_for_function("""
            () => {
                return document.readyState === 'complete' && 
                       (window.jQuery === undefined || jQuery.active === 0) &&
                       (window.angular === undefined || angular.element(document).injector().get('$http').pendingRequests.length === 0)
            }
        """, timeout=timeout)
        
        return self
    
    # Element interaction methods
    def click(self, selector: str, **kwargs) -> 'BasePage':
        """Click on an element with retry logic"""
        with allure.step(f"Click on element: {selector}"):
            element = self.page.locator(selector).first
            
            # Wait for element to be actionable
            element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=self.timeout)
            element.wait_for(state="enabled", timeout=self.timeout)
            
            # Scroll into view if needed
            element.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
            
            # Click with retry
            max_retries = 3
            for attempt in range(max_retries):
                try:
                    element.click(**kwargs)
                    logger.debug(f"Clicked element: {selector}")
                    break
                except Exception as e:
                    if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                        raise
                    logger.warning(f"Click failed (attempt {attempt + 1}): {e}")
                    time.sleep(0.5)
        
        return self
    
    def type(self, selector: str, text: str, clear_first: bool = True, **kwargs) -> 'BasePage':
        """Type text into an element with validation"""
        with allure.step(f"Type '{text}' into {selector}"):
            element = self.page.locator(selector).first
            element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=self.timeout)
            element.wait_for(state="enabled", timeout=self.timeout)
            
            if clear_first:
                element.clear()
            
            element.fill(text, **kwargs)
            
            # Verify text was entered
            actual_value = element.input_value()
            if actual_value != text:
                logger.warning(f"Text mismatch. Expected: '{text}', Got: '{actual_value}'")
            
            logger.debug(f"Typed '{text}' into {selector}")
        
        return self
    
    def select_option(self, selector: str, value: str, by_label: bool = False, **kwargs) -> 'BasePage':
        """Select an option from dropdown"""
        with allure.step(f"Select '{value}' from {selector}"):
            element = self.page.locator(selector).first
            element.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=self.timeout)
            
            if by_label:
                element.select_option(label=value, **kwargs)
            else:
                element.select_option(value=value, **kwargs)
            
            logger.debug(f"Selected '{value}' from {selector}")
        
        return self
    
    # Wait and synchronization methods
    def wait_for_element(self, selector: str, timeout: Optional[int] = None, 
                         state: str = "visible") -> Locator:
        """Wait for element to reach specified state"""
        timeout = timeout or self.timeout
        element = self.page.locator(selector).first
        element.wait_for(state=state, timeout=timeout)
        return element
    
    def wait_for_element_hidden(self, selector: str, timeout: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
        """Wait for element to be hidden"""
        timeout = timeout or self.timeout
        element = self.page.locator(selector).first
        return element.wait_for(state="hidden", timeout=timeout)
    
    def wait_for_condition(self, condition: Callable[[], bool], timeout: Optional[int] = None, 
                          message: str = "Condition not met") -> bool:
        """Wait for custom condition"""
        timeout = timeout or self.timeout
        end_time = time.time() + (timeout / 1000)
        
        while time.time() < end_time:
            if condition():
                return True
            time.sleep(self.poll_frequency / 1000)
        
        raise TimeoutError(f"{message} after {timeout}ms")
    
    # Assertion methods
    def assert_element_visible(self, selector: str, message: Optional[str] = None) -> 'BasePage':
        """Assert that element is visible"""
        with allure.step(f"Verify element is visible: {selector}"):
            element = self.page.locator(selector)
            expect(element).to_be_visible()
            
            if message:
                allure.attach(message, name="Assertion Message")
                logger.info(f"Assertion passed: {message}")
        
        return self
    
    def assert_element_text(self, selector: str, expected_text: str, 
                           exact: bool = False, **kwargs) -> 'BasePage':
        """Assert element contains expected text"""
        with allure.step(f"Verify '{expected_text}' in {selector}"):
            element = self.page.locator(selector)
            
            if exact:
                expect(element).to_have_text(expected_text, **kwargs)
            else:
                expect(element).to_contain_text(expected_text, **kwargs)
            
            logger.debug(f"Text assertion passed: '{expected_text}' found in {selector}")
        
        return self
    
    def assert_url_contains(self, expected_text: str) -> 'BasePage':
        """Assert URL contains expected text"""
        with allure.step(f"Verify URL contains '{expected_text}'"):
            expect(self.page).to_have_url(f".*{expected_text}.*")
            logger.debug(f"URL contains '{expected_text}': {self.page.url}")
        
        return self
    
    # Screenshot and recording methods
    def take_screenshot(self, name: Optional[str] = None, element_selector: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        """Take screenshot and attach to report"""
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        name = name or f"screenshot_{timestamp}"
        screenshot_path = f"screenshots/{name}.png"
        
        # Create directory if it doesn't exist
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(screenshot_path), exist_ok=True)
        
        # Take screenshot of element or full page
        if element_selector:
            element = self.page.locator(element_selector).first
            element.screenshot(path=screenshot_path)
        else:
            self.page.screenshot(path=screenshot_path, full_page=True)
        
        # Attach to Allure report
        allure.attach.file(
            screenshot_path,
            name=name,
            attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.PNG
        )
        
        logger.info(f"Screenshot saved: {screenshot_path}")
        return screenshot_path
    
    # JavaScript execution
    def execute_script(self, script: str, *args) -> any:
        """Execute JavaScript on the page"""
        return self.page.evaluate(script, *args)
    
    def scroll_to_element(self, selector: str) -> 'BasePage':
        """Scroll to element"""
        element = self.page.locator(selector)
        element.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
        return self
    
    # Frame handling
    def switch_to_frame(self, selector: str) -> 'BasePage':
        """Switch to iframe"""
        frame = self.page.frame_locator(selector)
        return BasePage(frame)
    
    # Alert handling
    def handle_alert(self, accept: bool = True, text: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
        """Handle JavaScript alert"""
        dialog_message = []
        
        def handle_dialog(dialog):
            dialog_message.append(dialog.message)
            
            with allure.step(f"Handle {dialog.type()} dialog: {dialog.message}"):
                if text and dialog.type() == "prompt":
                    dialog.accept(text)
                elif accept:
                    dialog.accept()
                else:
                    dialog.dismiss()
        
        self.page.on("dialog", handle_dialog)
        return dialog_message[0] if dialog_message else None
    
    # Utility methods
    def get_element_count(self, selector: str) -> int:
        """Get count of elements matching selector"""
        return self.page.locator(selector).count()
    
    def get_element_text(self, selector: str, index: int = 0) -> str:
        """Get text of element"""
        element = self.page.locator(selector).nth(index)
        return element.text_content() or ""
    
    def is_element_present(self, selector: str, timeout: int = 5000) -> bool:
        """Check if element is present (doesn't wait for visible)"""
        try:
            self.page.locator(selector).first.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=timeout)
            return True
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
            return False
    
    def is_element_visible(self, selector: str, timeout: int = 5000) -> bool:
        """Check if element is visible"""
        try:
            self.page.locator(selector).first.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            return True
        except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
            return False
    
    def is_element_enabled(self, selector: str) -> bool:
        """Check if element is enabled"""
        element = self.page.locator(selector).first
        return element.is_enabled()
    
    # Network interception
    def intercept_requests(self, url_pattern: str, response_handler: Callable):
        """Intercept network requests"""
        self.page.route(url_pattern, response_handler)
    
    def wait_for_request(self, url_pattern: str, timeout: Optional[int] = None) -> bool:
        """Wait for specific request to complete"""
        timeout = timeout or self.timeout
        with self.page.expect_request(url_pattern, timeout=timeout) as request_info:
            request = request_info.value
            logger.debug(f"Request completed: {request.method} {request.url}")
            return True
    
    # Cookie and storage management
    def get_cookies(self) -> List[dict]:
        """Get all cookies"""
        return self.page.context.cookies()
    
    def add_cookie(self, cookie: dict) -> 'BasePage':
        """Add a cookie"""
        self.page.context.add_cookies([cookie])
        return self
    
    def clear_cookies(self) -> 'BasePage':
        """Clear all cookies"""
        self.page.context.clear_cookies()
        return self
    
    def get_local_storage(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Get value from local storage"""
        return self.page.evaluate(f"localStorage.getItem('{key}');")
    
    def set_local_storage(self, key: str, value: str) -> 'BasePage':
        """Set value in local storage"""
        self.page.evaluate(f"localStorage.setItem('{key}', '{value}');")
        return self
    
    # Performance monitoring
    def get_performance_metrics(self) -> dict:
        """Get page performance metrics"""
        return self.page.evaluate("""
            () => {
                const [timing] = performance.getEntriesByType('navigation');
                return {
                    dns_lookup: timing.domainLookupEnd - timing.domainLookupStart,
                    tcp_connection: timing.connectEnd - timing.connectStart,
                    request_response: timing.responseEnd - timing.requestStart,
                    dom_loading: timing.domContentLoadedEventEnd - timing.domContentLoadedEventStart,
                    page_load: timing.loadEventEnd - timing.loadEventStart,
                    total_time: timing.loadEventEnd - timing.navigationStart
                };
            }
        """)

# src/database/connection.py
from typing import Optional, Dict, Any, List
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Engine, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, Session
from sqlalchemy.pool import QueuePool
from contextlib import contextmanager
from src.core.logger import get_logger
from src.config.base_config import get_config
import pandas as pd

logger = get_logger(__name__)

class DatabaseConnection:
    """Database connection manager with connection pooling"""
    
    _instance = None
    _engine: Optional[Engine] = None
    _SessionLocal: Optional[sessionmaker] = None
    
    def __new__(cls):
        if cls._instance is None:
            cls._instance = super(DatabaseConnection, cls).__new__(cls)
        return cls._instance
    
    def __init__(self):
        if not hasattr(self, 'initialized'):
            self.initialized = True
            self.config = get_config()
            self._setup_engine()
    
    def _setup_engine(self):
        """Setup SQLAlchemy engine with connection pooling"""
        connection_string = self._get_connection_string()
        
        engine_params = {
            "echo": self.config.debug,
            "poolclass": QueuePool,
            "pool_size": 10,
            "max_overflow": 20,
            "pool_timeout": 30,
            "pool_recycle": 3600,
            "pool_pre_ping": True,
            "isolation_level": "READ COMMITTED"
        }
        
        try:
            self._engine = create_engine(connection_string, **engine_params)
            self._SessionLocal = sessionmaker(
                autocommit=False,
                autoflush=False,
                bind=self._engine
            )
            
            logger.info(f"Database engine created for {self.config.db_name}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to create database engine: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _get_connection_string(self) -> str:
        """Get database connection string based on configuration"""
        if self.config.db_driver == "mysql":
            return f"mysql+pymysql://{self.config.db_user}:{self.config.db_password}@{self.config.db_host}:{self.config.db_port}/{self.config.db_name}?charset=utf8mb4"
        elif self.config.db_driver == "postgresql":
            return f"postgresql://{self.config.db_user}:{self.config.db_password}@{self.config.db_host}:{self.config.db_port}/{self.config.db_name}"
        elif self.config.db_driver == "sqlite":
            return f"sqlite:///{self.config.db_name}.db"
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported database driver: {self.config.db_driver}")
    
    @property
    def engine(self) -> Engine:
        """Get database engine"""
        if self._engine is None:
            self._setup_engine()
        return self._engine
    
    @contextmanager
    def get_session(self) -> Session:
        """Get database session with context manager"""
        session = self._SessionLocal()
        try:
            yield session
            session.commit()
        except Exception as e:
            session.rollback()
            logger.error(f"Database session error: {e}")
            raise
        finally:
            session.close()
    
    def test_connection(self) -> bool:
        """Test database connection"""
        try:
            with self.get_session() as session:
                session.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
            logger.info("Database connection test successful")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Database connection test failed: {e}")
            return False
    
    def execute_raw_sql(self, sql: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None) -> List[Dict]:
        """Execute raw SQL query and return results as dictionaries"""
        with self.get_session() as session:
            result = session.execute(text(sql), params or {})
            columns = result.keys()
            return [dict(zip(columns, row)) for row in result.fetchall()]
    
    def execute_many(self, sql: str, params_list: List[Dict]) -> int:
        """Execute SQL statement with multiple parameter sets"""
        with self.get_session() as session:
            result = session.execute(text(sql), params_list)
            session.commit()
            return result.rowcount
    
    def get_dataframe(self, sql: str, params: Optional[Dict] = None) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Execute SQL query and return results as pandas DataFrame"""
        with self.engine.connect() as connection:
            return pd.read_sql(sql, connection, params=params)
    
    def close(self):
        """Close database connections"""
        if self._engine:
            self._engine.dispose()
            self._engine = None
            self._SessionLocal = None
            logger.info("Database connections closed")

class DatabaseHelper:
    """Helper class for common database operations"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_connection: Optional[DatabaseConnection] = None):
        self.db = db_connection or DatabaseConnection()
    
    def table_exists(self, table_name: str) -> bool:
        """Check if table exists in database"""
        from sqlalchemy import inspect
        
        inspector = inspect(self.db.engine)
        return table_name in inspector.get_table_names()
    
    def get_table_row_count(self, table_name: str, where_clause: Optional[str] = None) -> int:
        """Get row count for a table"""
        sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name}"
        if where_clause:
            sql += f" WHERE {where_clause}"
        
        result = self.db.execute_raw_sql(sql)
        return int(result[0]["COUNT(*)"]) if result else 0
    
    def truncate_table(self, table_name: str, cascade: bool = False) -> bool:
        """Truncate table (delete all rows)"""
        try:
            cascade_clause = " CASCADE" if cascade else ""
            sql = f"TRUNCATE TABLE {table_name}{cascade_clause}"
            
            with self.db.get_session() as session:
                session.execute(text(sql))
                session.commit()
            
            logger.info(f"Table {table_name} truncated")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to truncate table {table_name}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def backup_table(self, table_name: str, backup_suffix: str = "_backup") -> bool:
        """Create backup of table"""
        backup_table = f"{table_name}{backup_suffix}"
        
        try:
            with self.db.get_session() as session:
                # Create backup table
                session.execute(text(f"CREATE TABLE {backup_table} AS SELECT * FROM {table_name}"))
                session.commit()
            
            logger.info(f"Table {table_name} backed up to {backup_table}")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to backup table {table_name}: {e}")
            return False
    
    def compare_tables(self, table1: str, table2: str, key_columns: List[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Compare data between two tables"""
        # Build comparison query
        key_columns_str = ", ".join(key_columns)
        
        comparison_results = {
            "table1": table1,
            "table2": table2,
            "differences": [],
            "table1_only": [],
            "table2_only": []
        }
        
        try:
            # Find rows only in table1
            sql = f"""
                SELECT {key_columns_str}
                FROM {table1} t1
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM {table2} t2
                    WHERE {' AND '.join([f't1.{col} = t2.{col}' for col in key_columns])}
                )
            """
            
            table1_only = self.db.execute_raw_sql(sql)
            comparison_results["table1_only"] = table1_only
            
            # Find rows only in table2
            sql = f"""
                SELECT {key_columns_str}
                FROM {table2} t2
                WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM {table1} t1
                    WHERE {' AND '.join([f't1.{col} = t2.{col}' for col in key_columns])}
                )
            """
            
            table2_only = self.db.execute_raw_sql(sql)
            comparison_results["table2_only"] = table2_only
            
            return comparison_results
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to compare tables: {e}")
            raise
    
    def verify_data_integrity(self, parent_table: str, child_table: str, 
                            parent_key: str, child_key: str) -> List[Dict]:
        """Verify referential integrity between tables"""
        sql = f"""
            SELECT c.*
            FROM {child_table} c
            LEFT JOIN {parent_table} p ON c.{child_key} = p.{parent_key}
            WHERE p.{parent_key} IS NULL
        """
        
        orphaned_records = self.db.execute_raw_sql(sql)
        return orphaned_records
    
    def execute_in_transaction(self, operations: List[Dict]) -> bool:
        """Execute multiple operations in a single transaction"""
        try:
            with self.db.get_session() as session:
                for operation in operations:
                    if operation["type"] == "insert":
                        table = operation["table"]
                        data = operation["data"]
                        columns = ", ".join(data.keys())
                        values = ", ".join([f":{key}" for key in data.keys()])
                        sql = f"INSERT INTO {table} ({columns}) VALUES ({values})"
                        session.execute(text(sql), data)
                    
                    elif operation["type"] == "update":
                        table = operation["table"]
                        data = operation["data"]
                        where = operation["where"]
                        set_clause = ", ".join([f"{key} = :{key}" for key in data.keys()])
                        sql = f"UPDATE {table} SET {set_clause} WHERE {where}"
                        session.execute(text(sql), {**data, **operation.get("params", {})})
                    
                    elif operation["type"] == "delete":
                        table = operation["table"]
                        where = operation["where"]
                        sql = f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE {where}"
                        session.execute(text(sql), operation.get("params", {}))
                
                session.commit()
                return True
                
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Transaction failed: {e}")
            raise

from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from src.database.connection import DatabaseHelper

class UserQueries:
    """User-related database queries"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_helper: Optional[DatabaseHelper] = None):
        self.db = db_helper or DatabaseHelper()
    
    def get_user_by_id(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get user by ID with all related information"""
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.phone, 
                u.role, u.is_active, u.created_at, u.updated_at,
                COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count,
                SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent,
                MAX(o.created_at) as last_order_date
            FROM users u
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
            WHERE u.id = :user_id
            GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, 
                     u.phone, u.role, u.is_active, u.created_at, u.updated_at
        """
        
        result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"user_id": user_id})
        return result[0] if result else None
    
    def get_user_by_email(self, email: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get user by email"""
        sql = """
            SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, phone, 
                   role, is_active, created_at, updated_at
            FROM users
            WHERE email = :email
        """
        
        result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"email": email})
        return result[0] if result else None
    
    def create_user(self, user_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        """Create new user"""
        sql = """
            INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, 
                              phone, role, is_active, created_at)
            VALUES (:email, :password_hash, :first_name, :last_name, 
                   :phone, :role, :is_active, NOW())
        """
        
        with self.db.db.get_session() as session:
            result = session.execute(text(sql), user_data)
            session.commit()
            return result.lastrowid
    
    def update_user_profile(self, user_id: int, profile_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Update user profile"""
        if not profile_data:
            return False
        
        set_clause = ", ".join([f"{key} = :{key}" for key in profile_data.keys()])
        sql = f"""
            UPDATE users
            SET {set_clause}, updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = :user_id
        """
        
        params = profile_data.copy()
        params["user_id"] = user_id
        
        with self.db.db.get_session() as session:
            result = session.execute(text(sql), params)
            session.commit()
            return result.rowcount > 0
    
    def get_active_users_count(self, days: int = 30) -> int:
        """Get count of users active in last N days"""
        sql = """
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as active_users
            FROM (
                SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL :days DAY)
                UNION
                SELECT user_id FROM user_sessions WHERE last_activity >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL :days DAY)
            ) active_users
        """
        
        result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"days": days})
        return int(result[0]["active_users"]) if result else 0
    
    def get_users_by_purchase_value(self, min_amount: float = 100.0, 
                                   limit: int = 100) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get users with purchase value above threshold"""
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name,
                COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
                SUM(o.total_amount) as total_spent,
                AVG(o.total_amount) as avg_order_value,
                MAX(o.created_at) as last_purchase_date
            FROM users u
            JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
            WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
            GROUP BY u.id, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name
            HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) >= :min_amount
            ORDER BY total_spent DESC
            LIMIT :limit
        """
        
        return self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"min_amount": min_amount, "limit": limit})

# src/database/queries/product_queries.py
class ProductQueries:
    """Product-related database queries"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_helper: Optional[DatabaseHelper] = None):
        self.db = db_helper or DatabaseHelper()
    
    def get_product_inventory(self, product_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get product inventory information"""
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.stock_quantity,
                COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as sold_last_30_days,
                p.stock_quantity - COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as available_stock,
                CASE 
                    WHEN p.stock_quantity <= 10 THEN 'LOW'
                    WHEN p.stock_quantity <= 50 THEN 'MEDIUM'
                    ELSE 'HIGH'
                END as stock_level
            FROM products p
            LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
            LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id 
                AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
                AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
            WHERE p.id = :product_id
            GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.stock_quantity
        """
        
        result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"product_id": product_id})
        return result[0] if result else {}
    
    def update_product_stock(self, product_id: int, quantity_change: int) -> bool:
        """Update product stock quantity atomically"""
        sql = """
            UPDATE products
            SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :quantity_change,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = :product_id
            AND stock_quantity + :quantity_change >= 0
        """
        
        with self.db.db.get_session() as session:
            result = session.execute(text(sql), {
                "product_id": product_id,
                "quantity_change": quantity_change
            })
            session.commit()
            return result.rowcount > 0
    
    def get_top_selling_products(self, days: int = 30, limit: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get top selling products"""
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.category, p.price,
                SUM(oi.quantity) as units_sold,
                SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) as revenue,
                COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as order_count
            FROM products p
            JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
            JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
            WHERE o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL :days DAY)
                AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
            GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sku, p.category, p.price
            ORDER BY units_sold DESC
            LIMIT :limit
        """
        
        return self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"days": days, "limit": limit})
    
    def get_products_with_low_stock(self, threshold: int = 10) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get products with low stock"""
        sql = """
            SELECT id, name, sku, category, stock_quantity,
                   (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items oi 
                    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id 
                    WHERE oi.product_id = p.id 
                    AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) as weekly_demand
            FROM products p
            WHERE stock_quantity <= :threshold
            ORDER BY stock_quantity ASC, weekly_demand DESC
        """
        
        return self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"threshold": threshold})

# src/database/queries/order_queries.py
class OrderQueries:
    """Order-related database queries"""
    
    def __init__(self, db_helper: Optional[DatabaseHelper] = None):
        self.db = db_helper or DatabaseHelper()
    
    def get_order_with_details(self, order_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get order with all details and items"""
        # Get order information
        order_sql = """
            SELECT 
                o.*,
                u.email as user_email,
                u.first_name as user_first_name,
                u.last_name as user_last_name,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = o.id) as item_count,
                (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = o.id) as total_items
            FROM orders o
            JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
            WHERE o.id = :order_id
        """
        
        order_result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(order_sql, {"order_id": order_id})
        if not order_result:
            return None
        
        order = order_result[0]
        
        # Get order items
        items_sql = """
            SELECT 
                oi.*,
                p.name as product_name,
                p.sku as product_sku,
                p.category as product_category
            FROM order_items oi
            JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
            WHERE oi.order_id = :order_id
            ORDER BY oi.id
        """
        
        order_items = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(items_sql, {"order_id": order_id})
        order["items"] = order_items
        
        return order
    
    def create_order_with_items(self, order_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Create new order with order items in a transaction"""
        operations = []
        
        # Add order creation operation
        order_fields = ["id", "user_id", "total_amount", "status", 
                       "shipping_address", "billing_address",
                       "payment_method", "payment_status", "shipping_method"]
        order_insert_data = {k: order_data[k] for k in order_fields if k in order_data}
        
        operations.append({
            "type": "insert",
            "table": "orders",
            "data": order_insert_data
        })
        
        # Add order items operations
        for item in order_data.get("items", []):
            item_data = {
                "order_id": order_data["id"],
                "product_id": item["product_id"],
                "quantity": item["quantity"],
                "price": item["price"]
            }
            
            operations.append({
                "type": "insert",
                "table": "order_items",
                "data": item_data
            })
            
            # Update product stock
            operations.append({
                "type": "update",
                "table": "products",
                "data": {"stock_quantity": -item["quantity"]},
                "where": "id = :product_id",
                "params": {"product_id": item["product_id"]}
            })
        
        # Execute all operations in a transaction
        self.db.execute_in_transaction(operations)
        return order_data["id"]
    
    def get_daily_sales_report(self, date: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get daily sales report"""
        target_date = date or datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                DATE(o.created_at) as sale_date,
                COUNT(*) as order_count,
                SUM(o.total_amount) as total_revenue,
                AVG(o.total_amount) as avg_order_value,
                MIN(o.total_amount) as min_order_value,
                MAX(o.total_amount) as max_order_value,
                SUM(oi.quantity) as total_items_sold,
                COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) as unique_customers
            FROM orders o
            JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
            WHERE DATE(o.created_at) = :target_date
                AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
            GROUP BY DATE(o.created_at)
        """
        
        result = self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"target_date": target_date})
        
        if result:
            return result[0]
        else:
            return {
                "sale_date": target_date,
                "order_count": 0,
                "total_revenue": 0.0,
                "avg_order_value": 0.0,
                "min_order_value": 0.0,
                "max_order_value": 0.0,
                "total_items_sold": 0,
                "unique_customers": 0
            }
    
    def get_orders_by_status_timeline(self, status: str, hours: int = 24) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get orders stuck in a status for too long"""
        sql = """
            SELECT 
                o.id, o.user_id, o.total_amount, o.created_at,
                u.email as user_email,
                TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.created_at, NOW()) as hours_in_status
            FROM orders o
            JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
            WHERE o.status = :status
                AND o.created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL :hours HOUR)
            ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
        """
        
        return self.db.db.execute_raw_sql(sql, {"status": status, "hours": hours})

# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: ShopSmart Test Automation CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
    paths-ignore:
      - '**/*.md'
      - '**/*.txt'
      - 'docs/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Daily at 2 AM
  workflow_dispatch:  # Manual trigger

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.9'
  NODE_VERSION: '18'
  DATABASE_IMAGE: 'mysql:8.0'
  
jobs:
  setup-and-lint:
    name: Setup and Code Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
        cache: 'pip'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install black isort flake8 mypy bandit safety
    
    - name: Run Black (code formatting)
      run: black --check .
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Run Isort (import sorting)
      run: isort --check-only .
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Run Flake8 (linting)
      run: flake8 . --count --max-complexity=10 --statistics
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Run MyPy (type checking)
      run: mypy src/ --ignore-missing-imports
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Run Bandit (security scanning)
      run: bandit -r src/ -f json -o reports/bandit-report.json
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Run Safety (dependency checking)
      run: safety check --json -o reports/safety-report.json
      continue-on-error: true
    
    - name: Upload code quality reports
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: code-quality-reports
        path: reports/*-report.json
        retention-days: 7

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: setup-and-lint
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov pytest-mock pytest-xdist
    
    - name: Run unit tests with coverage
      run: |
        pytest tests/unit/ \
          -v \
          --junitxml=reports/junit/unit-tests.xml \
          --cov=src \
          --cov-report=xml:reports/coverage.xml \
          --cov-report=html:reports/coverage-html \
          --cov-fail-under=80
    
    - name: Upload unit test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: unit-test-results
        path: |
          reports/junit/unit-tests.xml
          reports/coverage.xml
          reports/coverage-html/
        retention-days: 30
    
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        files: reports/coverage.xml
        flags: unittests
        name: codecov-umbrella

  api-tests:
    name: API Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit-tests
    
    services:
      mysql:
        image: mysql:8.0
        env:
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root123
          MYSQL_DATABASE: shopsmart_test
          MYSQL_USER: test_user
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: test_pass
        ports:
          - 3306:3306
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping"
          --health-interval=10s
          --health-timeout=5s
          --health-retries=3
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-html allure-pytest
    
    - name: Wait for MySQL
      run: sleep 30
    
    - name: Setup test database
      env:
        DB_HOST: localhost
        DB_PORT: 3306
        DB_NAME: shopsmart_test
        DB_USER: root
        DB_PASSWORD: root123
      run: |
        python scripts/setup_test_db.py
        python scripts/seed_test_data.py
    
    - name: Run API tests
      env:
        API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
        DB_HOST: localhost
        DB_PORT: 3306
        DB_NAME: shopsmart_test
        DB_USER: test_user
        DB_PASSWORD: test_pass
      run: |
        pytest tests/api/ \
          -v \
          -n 4 \
          --junitxml=reports/junit/api-tests.xml \
          --html=reports/html/api-report.html \
          --self-contained-html \
          --alluredir=reports/allure/api
    
    - name: Upload API test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: api-test-results
        path: |
          reports/junit/api-tests.xml
          reports/html/api-report.html
          reports/allure/api/
        retention-days: 30

  web-ui-tests:
    name: Web UI Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: api-tests
    strategy:
      matrix:
        browser: [chrome, firefox]
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10']
      fail-fast: false
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Install system dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y libmysqlclient-dev
        sudo apt-get install -y playwright
    
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-html allure-pytest pytest-xdist
    
    - name: Install Playwright browsers
      run: |
        python -m playwright install ${{ matrix.browser }}
        python -m playwright install-deps
    
    - name: Run Web UI tests
      env:
        BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
        BROWSER: ${{ matrix.browser }}
        HEADLESS: true
        PARALLEL_WORKERS: 4
      run: |
        pytest tests/web/ \
          -v \
          -n $PARALLEL_WORKERS \
          --dist=loadscope \
          --junitxml=reports/junit/web-tests-${{ matrix.browser }}.xml \
          --html=reports/html/web-report-${{ matrix.browser }}.html \
          --self-contained-html \
          --alluredir=reports/allure/web-${{ matrix.browser }}
    
    - name: Upload Web UI test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: web-test-results-${{ matrix.browser }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
        path: |
          reports/junit/web-tests-${{ matrix.browser }}.xml
          reports/html/web-report-${{ matrix.browser }}.html
          reports/allure/web-${{ matrix.browser }}/
          screenshots/
          videos/
        retention-days: 30

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: web-ui-tests
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-html allure-pytest
    
    - name: Run integration tests
      env:
        BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
        API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
        DB_HOST: localhost
        DB_PORT: 3306
        DB_NAME: shopsmart_test
        DB_USER: test_user
        DB_PASSWORD: test_pass
      run: |
        pytest tests/integration/ \
          -v \
          --junitxml=reports/junit/integration-tests.xml \
          --html=reports/html/integration-report.html \
          --self-contained-html \
          --alluredir=reports/allure/integration
    
    - name: Upload integration test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: integration-test-results
        path: |
          reports/junit/integration-tests.xml
          reports/html/integration-report.html
          reports/allure/integration/
        retention-days: 30

  performance-tests:
    name: Performance Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: integration-tests
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install locust py-spy
    
    - name: Run performance tests
      env:
        API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
      run: |
        locust -f tests/performance/locustfile.py \
          --headless \
          --users 100 \
          --spawn-rate 10 \
          --run-time 5m \
          --html=reports/html/performance-report.html \
          --csv=reports/performance
    
    - name: Upload performance test results
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      if: always()
      with:
        name: performance-test-results
        path: |
          reports/html/performance-report.html
          reports/performance*.csv
        retention-days: 30

  generate-reports:
    name: Generate Test Reports
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [api-tests, web-ui-tests, integration-tests]
    if: always()
    
    steps:
    - name: Download test artifacts
      uses: actions/download-artifact@v3
    
    - name: Setup Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Install Allure
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y default-jre
        wget https://github.com/allure-framework/allure2/releases/download/2.21.0/allure-2.21.0.tgz
        tar -xvzf allure-2.21.0.tgz
        sudo mv allure-2.21.0 /opt/allure
        sudo ln -s /opt/allure/bin/allure /usr/bin/allure
    
    - name: Generate Allure report
      run: |
        allure generate reports/allure --clean -o reports/allure-report
    
    - name: Generate test summary
      run: |
        python scripts/generate_test_summary.py
    
    - name: Upload final reports
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: final-test-reports
        path: |
          reports/allure-report/
          reports/test-summary.md
          reports/metrics.json
        retention-days: 90
    
    - name: Deploy Allure report to GitHub Pages
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v3
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./reports/allure-report
        keep_files: false

  quality-gates:
    name: Quality Gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [unit-tests, api-tests, web-ui-tests, integration-tests, generate-reports]
    if: always()
    
    steps:
    - name: Check test results
      run: |
        python scripts/check_quality_gates.py
    
    - name: Fail if quality gates not met
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "Quality gates failed. Check test results for details."
        exit 1

# src/core/reporting.py
import json
import csv
import yaml
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
from src.core.logger import get_logger

logger = get_logger(__name__)

class TestReporter:
    """Generate comprehensive test reports and metrics"""
    
    def __init__(self, report_dir: str = "reports"):
        self.report_dir = report_dir
        self.metrics = {
            "test_execution": {},
            "performance": {},
            "coverage": {},
            "quality": {}
        }
    
    def generate_execution_summary(self, test_results: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate test execution summary"""
        summary = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "total_tests": test_results.get("total", 0),
            "passed": test_results.get("passed", 0),
            "failed": test_results.get("failed", 0),
            "skipped": test_results.get("skipped", 0),
            "success_rate": (test_results.get("passed", 0) / test_results.get("total", 1)) * 100,
            "execution_time": test_results.get("execution_time", 0),
            "test_suite": test_results.get("suite", "unknown")
        }
        
        # Calculate additional metrics
        if test_results.get("total", 0) > 0:
            summary["failure_rate"] = (test_results.get("failed", 0) / test_results.get("total", 1)) * 100
            summary["skip_rate"] = (test_results.get("skipped", 0) / test_results.get("total", 1)) * 100
            summary["tests_per_minute"] = test_results.get("total", 0) / (test_results.get("execution_time", 1) / 60)
        
        return summary
    
    def generate_html_dashboard(self, metrics_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Generate interactive HTML dashboard"""
        fig = make_subplots(
            rows=3, cols=2,
            subplot_titles=('Test Results Overview', 'Execution Time Trend', 
                          'Failure Analysis', 'Coverage Trend',
                          'Performance Metrics', 'Quality Gates'),
            specs=[[{'type': 'pie'}, {'type': 'scatter'}],
                   [{'type': 'bar'}, {'type': 'scatter'}],
                   [{'type': 'indicator'}, {'type': 'indicator'}]]
        )
        
        # Test Results Pie Chart
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Pie(
                labels=['Passed', 'Failed', 'Skipped'],
                values=[
                    metrics_data.get('passed', 0),
                    metrics_data.get('failed', 0),
                    metrics_data.get('skipped', 0)
                ],
                hole=.3,
                marker_colors=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c', '#f39c12']
            ),
            row=1, col=1
        )
        
        # Execution Time Trend
        execution_trend = metrics_data.get('execution_trend', [])
        if execution_trend:
            dates = [item['date'] for item in execution_trend]
            times = [item['execution_time'] for item in execution_trend]
            
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Scatter(
                    x=dates,
                    y=times,
                    mode='lines+markers',
                    name='Execution Time',
                    line=dict(color='#3498db', width=2)
                ),
                row=1, col=2
            )
        
        # Failure Analysis
        failure_causes = metrics_data.get('failure_causes', {})
        if failure_causes:
            fig.add_trace(
                go.Bar(
                    x=list(failure_causes.keys()),
                    y=list(failure_causes.values()),
                    name='Failure Causes',

    def track_metrics(self, test_run_data: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Track test metrics over time"""
        timestamp = datetime.now().isoformat()
        
        self.metrics["test_execution"][timestamp] = {
            "total_tests": test_run_data.get("total", 0),
            "passed": test_run_data.get("passed", 0),
            "failed": test_run_data.get("failed", 0),
            "skipped": test_run_data.get("skipped", 0),
            "success_rate": test_run_data.get("success_rate", 0),
            "execution_time": test_run_data.get("execution_time", 0),
            "test_suite": test_run_data.get("test_suite", "unknown")
        }
        
        # Save metrics to file
        self._save_metrics()
    
    def _save_metrics(self):
        """Save metrics to JSON file"""
        metrics_file = f"{self.report_dir}/metrics.json"
        
        with open(metrics_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.metrics, f, indent=2, default=str)
    
    def generate_trend_report(self, days: int = 30) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate trend analysis report"""
        # Load historical metrics
        metrics_file = f"{self.report_dir}/metrics.json"
        
        try:
            with open(metrics_file, 'r') as f:
                historical_metrics = json.load(f)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            logger.warning("No historical metrics found")
            return {}
        
        # Filter data for specified days
        cutoff_date = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=days)
        filtered_data = {}
        
        for timestamp, metrics in historical_metrics.get("test_execution", {}).items():
            if datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp) >= cutoff_date:
                filtered_data[timestamp] = metrics
        
        # Calculate trends
        if not filtered_data:
            return {}
        
        df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(filtered_data, orient='index')
        
        trends = {
            "success_rate_trend": df["success_rate"].tolist(),
            "execution_time_trend": df["execution_time"].tolist(),
            "test_count_trend": df["total_tests"].tolist(),
            "average_success_rate": df["success_rate"].mean(),
            "average_execution_time": df["execution_time"].mean(),
            "stability_score": self._calculate_stability_score(df),
            "trend_direction": self._calculate_trend_direction(df),
            "predictions": self._generate_predictions(df)
        }
        
        return trends
    
    def _calculate_stability_score(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> float:
        """Calculate test stability score"""
        if len(df) < 2:
            return 0
        
        # Calculate variance in success rate
        success_rate_var = df["success_rate"].var()
        
        # Calculate failure rate changes
        failure_rates = 100 - df["success_rate"]
        failure_rate_changes = failure_rates.diff().abs().mean()
        
        # Stability score (0-100, higher is better)
        stability = 100 - (success_rate_var + failure_rate_changes)
        return max(0, min(100, stability))
    
    def _calculate_trend_direction(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
        """Calculate trend direction"""
        if len(df) < 2:
            return "unknown"
        
        # Calculate slope of success rate
        x = range(len(df))
        y = df["success_rate"].values
        slope = np.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0]
        
        if slope > 1:
            return "strongly_improving"
        elif slope > 0.1:
            return "improving"
        elif slope < -1:
            return "strongly_declining"
        elif slope < -0.1:
            return "declining"
        else:
            return "stable"
    
    def _generate_predictions(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate predictions based on historical data"""
        if len(df) < 5:
            return {}
        
        try:
            # Simple linear regression for prediction
            x = range(len(df))
            y_success = df["success_rate"].values
            
            # Fit linear model
            coeff_success = np.polyfit(x, y_success, 1)
            
            # Predict next 7 days
            future_days = 7
            future_x = range(len(df), len(df) + future_days)
            future_success = np.polyval(coeff_success, future_x)
            
            predictions = {
                "next_7_days_success": future_success.tolist(),
                "predicted_success_rate": future_success[-1],
                "confidence_interval": {
                    "lower": max(0, future_success[-1] - 5),
                    "upper": min(100, future_success[-1] + 5)
                }
            }
            
            return predictions
            
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to generate predictions: {e}")
            return {}

class QualityGateManager:
    """Manage quality gates for test automation"""
    
    DEFAULT_GATES = {
        "test_success_rate": {
            "metric": "success_rate",
            "threshold": 95.0,
            "operator": ">=",
            "severity": "ERROR",
            "description": "Minimum test success rate"
        },
        "code_coverage": {
            "metric": "coverage",
            "threshold": 80.0,
            "operator": ">=",
            "severity": "WARNING",
            "description": "Minimum code coverage"
        },
        "api_response_time": {
            "metric": "api_avg_response_time",
            "threshold": 2000.0,
            "operator": "<",
            "severity": "WARNING",
            "description": "Maximum average API response time"
        },
        "test_flakiness": {
            "metric": "flaky_test_rate",
            "threshold": 5.0,
            "operator": "<",
            "severity": "ERROR",
            "description": "Maximum flaky test rate"
        },
        "security_issues": {
            "metric": "security_vulnerabilities",
            "threshold": 0,
            "operator": "==",
            "severity": "ERROR",
            "description": "No security vulnerabilities allowed"
        }
    }
    
    def __init__(self, gates: Optional[Dict] = None):
        self.gates = gates or self.DEFAULT_GATES
        self.results: Dict[str, Dict] = {}
    
    def evaluate_quality_gates(self, metrics: Dict[str, float]) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Evaluate all quality gates against provided metrics"""
        evaluation_results = {}
        
        for gate_name, gate_config in self.gates.items():
            metric_value = metrics.get(gate_config["metric"], 0)
            threshold = gate_config["threshold"]
            operator = gate_config["operator"]
            
            # Evaluate gate
            passed = self._evaluate_gate(metric_value, threshold, operator)
            
            evaluation_results[gate_name] = {
                "passed": passed,
                "metric": gate_config["metric"],
                "value": metric_value,
                "threshold": threshold,
                "operator": operator,
                "severity": gate_config["severity"],
                "description": gate_config["description"],
                "status": "PASS" if passed else "FAIL"
            }
            
            self.results[gate_name] = evaluation_results[gate_name]
        
        return evaluation_results
    
    def _evaluate_gate(self, value: float, threshold: float, operator: str) -> bool:
        """Evaluate single quality gate"""
        if operator == ">":
            return value > threshold
        elif operator == "<":
            return value < threshold
        elif operator == ">=":
            return value >= threshold
        elif operator == "<=":
            return value <= threshold
        elif operator == "==":
            return value == threshold
        elif operator == "!=":
            return value != threshold
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported operator: {operator}")
    
    def check_pipeline_pass(self) -> bool:
        """Check if pipeline should pass based on quality gates"""
        for gate_name, result in self.results.items():
            if not result["passed"] and result["severity"] == "ERROR":
                return False
        return True
    
    def generate_quality_report(self, evaluation_results: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
        """Generate quality gate report"""
        report = {
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "total_gates": len(evaluation_results),
            "passed_gates": sum(1 for r in evaluation_results.values() if r["passed"]),
            "failed_gates": sum(1 for r in evaluation_results.values() if not r["passed"]),
            "gate_results": evaluation_results,
            "pipeline_passed": self.check_pipeline_pass()
        }
        
        # Save report
        report_file = "reports/quality_gates.json"
        with open(report_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
        
        # Generate summary
        summary = self._generate_summary(report)
        return summary
    
    def _generate_summary(self, report: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Generate human-readable summary"""
        lines = []
        lines.append("=" * 60)
        lines.append("QUALITY GATE REPORT")
        lines.append("=" * 60)
        lines.append(f"Timestamp: {report['timestamp']}")
        lines.append(f"Total Gates: {report['total_gates']}")
        lines.append(f"Passed Gates: {report['passed_gates']}")
        lines.append(f"Failed Gates: {report['failed_gates']}")
        lines.append("-" * 60)
        
        for gate_name, result in report["gate_results"].items():
            status_icon = "✅" if result["passed"] else "❌"
            severity_icon = "🛑" if result["severity"] == "ERROR" else "⚠️"
            lines.append(f"{status_icon} {severity_icon} {gate_name}: {result['value']} {result['operator']} {result['threshold']}")
            if not result["passed"]:
                lines.append(f"   {result['description']}")
        
        lines.append("-" * 60)
        if report["pipeline_passed"]:
            lines.append("✅ PIPELINE PASSED - Deployment can proceed")
        else:
            lines.append("❌ PIPELINE FAILED - Deployment blocked")
            
            # List failed gates
            failed_gates = [name for name, result in report["gate_results"].items() if not result["passed"]]
            lines.append("Failed gates:" + ", ".join(failed_gates))
        
        lines.append("=" * 60)
        
        return "\n".join(lines)

# src/web/visual_testing.py
import base64
import hashlib
from typing import Optional, Tuple, Dict, Any, List
from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageStat
import io
import numpy as np
from src.core.logger import get_logger
import os

logger = get_logger(__name__)

class VisualTester:
    """Visual testing utilities using perceptual image comparison"""
    
    def __init__(self, threshold: float = 0.01):
        self.threshold = threshold  # 1% difference threshold
        self.baseline_dir = "visual_baselines"
        self.diff_dir = "visual_diffs"
        os.makedirs(self.baseline_dir, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(self.diff_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    def capture_screenshot(self, page, element_selector: Optional[str] = None, 
                          name: str = "screenshot") -> Image.Image:
        """Capture screenshot of page or element"""
        if element_selector:
            element = page.locator(element_selector).first
            screenshot_bytes = element.screenshot()
        else:
            screenshot_bytes = page.screenshot(full_page=True)
        
        image = Image.open(io.BytesIO(screenshot_bytes))
        
        # Save screenshot for debugging
        debug_dir = "screenshots/debug"
        os.makedirs(debug_dir, exist_ok=True)
        debug_path = f"{debug_dir}/{name}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.png"
        image.save(debug_path)
        
        return image
    
    def compare_with_baseline(self, test_name: str, current_image: Image.Image, 
                            element_selector: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[bool, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Compare current image with baseline"""
        # Load baseline
        baseline = self.load_baseline(test_name, element_selector)
        
        if baseline is None:
            # First run - save as baseline
            self.save_baseline(current_image, test_name, element_selector)
            logger.info(f"Created baseline for {test_name}")
            return True, {"status": "baseline_created", "difference_score": 0.0}
        
        # Compare images
        match, diff_score, diff_data = self.compare_images(baseline, current_image)
        
        if not match:
            # Generate diff image
            diff_image = self.generate_diff_image(baseline, current_image)
            
            # Save diff for investigation
            diff_path = f"{self.diff_dir}/{test_name}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.png"
            diff_image.save(diff_path)
            
            diff_data["diff_path"] = diff_path
            logger.warning(f"Visual test failed for {test_name}. Difference: {diff_score:.3f}")
        
        return match, {"status": "passed" if match else "failed", "difference_score": diff_score, **diff_data}
    
    def compare_images(self, image1: Image.Image, image2: Image.Image, 
                      mask_regions: Optional[List[Tuple[int, int, int, int]]] = None) -> Tuple[bool, float, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Compare two images with perceptual difference"""
        # Ensure images are same size
        if image1.size != image2.size:
            image2 = image2.resize(image1.size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        
        # Convert to RGB if necessary
        if image1.mode != 'RGB':
            image1 = image1.convert('RGB')
        if image2.mode != 'RGB':
            image2 = image2.convert('RGB')
        
        # Apply masks if specified
        if mask_regions:
            image1 = self._apply_masks(image1, mask_regions)
            image2 = self._apply_masks(image2, mask_regions)
        
        # Calculate structural similarity index
        similarity_score = self._calculate_ssim(image1, image2)
        diff_score = 1 - similarity_score
        
        # Find difference regions
        diff_regions = self._find_difference_regions(image1, image2)
        
        match = diff_score <= self.threshold
        
        return match, diff_score, {
            "similarity_score": similarity_score,
            "difference_score": diff_score,
            "threshold": self.threshold,
            "diff_regions": diff_regions,
            "image_size": image1.size
        }
    
    def _calculate_ssim(self, img1: Image.Image, img2: Image.Image) -> float:
        """Calculate Structural Similarity Index"""
        # Convert to numpy arrays
        img1_arr = np.array(img1).astype(np.float64)
        img2_arr = np.array(img2).astype(np.float64)
        
        # Constants for SSIM calculation
        C1 = (0.01 * 255) ** 2
        C2 = (0.03 * 255) ** 2
        
        # Calculate means
        mu1 = np.mean(img1_arr)
        mu2 = np.mean(img2_arr)
        
        # Calculate variances and covariance
        sigma1_sq = np.var(img1_arr)
        sigma2_sq = np.var(img2_arr)
        sigma12 = np.cov(img1_arr.flatten(), img2_arr.flatten())[0, 1]
        
        # Calculate SSIM
        numerator = (2 * mu1 * mu2 + C1) * (2 * sigma12 + C2)
        denominator = (mu1 ** 2 + mu2 ** 2 + C1) * (sigma1_sq + sigma2_sq + C2)
        
        return numerator / denominator if denominator != 0 else 0
    
    def _apply_masks(self, image: Image.Image, mask_regions: List[Tuple[int, int, int, int]]) -> Image.Image:
        """Apply masks to image regions"""
        masked_image = image.copy()
        
        for region in mask_regions:
            x, y, width, height = region
            mask = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), (0, 0, 0))
            masked_image.paste(mask, (x, y))
        
        return masked_image
    
    def _find_difference_regions(self, img1: Image.Image, img2: Image.Image, 
                               threshold: int = 30) -> List[Dict[str, int]]:
        """Find regions with significant differences"""
        # Calculate absolute difference
        diff = ImageChops.difference(img1, img2)
        diff_gray = diff.convert('L')
        
        # Apply threshold
        binary_diff = diff_gray.point(lambda x: 255 if x > threshold else 0)
        
        # Find contours
        diff_array = np.array(binary_diff)
        contours = []
        
        # Find connected components
        from scipy import ndimage
        labeled_array, num_features = ndimage.label(diff_array)
        
        for i in range(1, num_features + 1):
            # Get bounding box of component
            positions = np.argwhere(labeled_array == i)
            if len(positions) > 0:
                y_min, x_min = positions.min(axis=0)
                y_max, x_max = positions.max(axis=0)
                
                contours.append({
                    "x": int(x_min),
                    "y": int(y_min),
                    "width": int(x_max - x_min),
                    "height": int(y_max - y_min),
                    "area": len(positions)
                })
        
        return contours
    
    def generate_diff_image(self, image1: Image.Image, image2: Image.Image, 
                          highlight_color: Tuple[int, int, int] = (255, 0, 0)) -> Image.Image:
        """Generate visual diff image"""
        # Ensure same size
        if image1.size != image2.size:
            image2 = image2.resize(image1.size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        
        # Create diff image
        diff = ImageChops.difference(image1, image2)
        
        # Convert diff to highlight color
        diff_gray = diff.convert('L')
        diff_highlighted = Image.new('RGB', diff_gray.size, highlight_color)
        diff_highlighted.putalpha(diff_gray)
        
        # Overlay on original with some transparency
        result = image1.copy()
        result.paste(diff_highlighted, (0, 0), diff_highlighted)
        
        return result
    
    def save_baseline(self, image: Image.Image, test_name: str, 
                     element_selector: Optional[str] = None):
        """Save baseline screenshot"""
        filename = f"{self.baseline_dir}/{test_name}"
        if element_selector:
            selector_hash = hashlib.md5(element_selector.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
            filename += f"_{selector_hash}"
        filename += ".png"
        
        image.save(filename)
        logger.info(f"Baseline saved: {filename}")
        
        # Save metadata
        metadata = {
            "test_name": test_name,
            "element_selector": element_selector,
            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
            "image_size": image.size,
            "image_mode": image.mode,
            "threshold": self.threshold
        }
        
        metadata_file = f"{self.baseline_dir}/{test_name}.json"
        with open(metadata_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(metadata, f, indent=2)
    
    def load_baseline(self, test_name: str, element_selector: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
        """Load baseline screenshot"""
        filename = f"{self.baseline_dir}/{test_name}"
        if element_selector:
            selector_hash = hashlib.md5(element_selector.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
            filename += f"_{selector_hash}"
        filename += ".png"
        
        if os.path.exists(filename):
            return Image.open(filename)
        
        return None

            "locust",
            "-f", __file__,
            "--headless",
            "--users", str(users),
            "--spawn-rate", str(spawn_rate),
            "--run-time", duration,
            "--host", host,
            "--csv", "reports/performance/locust"
        ]
        
        result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
        
        # Parse results
        if result.returncode == 0:
            # Load statistics
            stats_file = "reports/performance/locust_stats.csv"
            if os.path.exists(stats_file):
                import pandas as pd
                
                stats_df = pd.read_csv(stats_file)
                stats = self._parse_locust_stats(stats_df)
                
                # Analyze results
                analysis = self.analyze_locust_results(stats)
                
                # Check SLA compliance
                slas = {
                    "/api/v1/products": 500,
                    "/api/v1/products/1": 1000,
                    "/api/v1/cart": 800,
                    "/api/v1/orders": 1500
                }
                compliance = self.check_sla_compliance(analysis, slas)
                
                # Generate report
                report_file = self.generate_performance_report(analysis, compliance)
                
                logger.info(f"Performance test completed. Report saved to: {report_file}")
                return {"success": True, "report": report_file, "analysis": analysis}
        
        logger.error(f"Performance test failed: {result.stderr}")
        return {"success": False, "error": result.stderr}
    
    def _parse_locust_stats(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Parse Locust statistics"""
        stats = {
            "num_requests": int(df["Request Count"].sum()),
            "num_failures": int(df["Failure Count"].sum()),
            "total_rps": float(df["Requests/s"].mean()),
            "entries": {}
        }
        
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            stats["entries"][row["Name"]] = {
                "num_requests": int(row["Request Count"]),
                "num_failures": int(row["Failure Count"]),
                "avg_response_time": float(row["Average Response Time"]),
                "min_response_time": float(row["Min Response Time"]),
                "max_response_time": float(row["Max Response Time"]),
                "median_response_time": float(row["Median Response Time"]),
                "total_rps": float(row["Requests/s"])
            }
        
        return stats
